context:
Ran daily intelligence scan for April 20, 2026. Scanned GitHub trending repos, web research on agent frameworks, and arxiv papers on LLM reasoning/planning.

Key findings:
1. FLARE paper (arXiv:2601.22311) — proves ReAct is a greedy policy, proposes MCTS lookahead with receding-horizon. LLaMA-8B+FLARE beats GPT-4o. Highly relevant for Hermes delegation.
2. Pre-Act paper (arXiv:2505.09970) — multi-step planning with iterative refinement. 70% improvement over ReAct. Validates plan-then-refine approach.
3. Franklin repo — autonomous agent with USDC wallet, learned Smart Router with Elo scoring for model selection. MCP auto-discovery pattern.
4. StateWalker — FSM-based agent framework as alternative to ReAct loops.
5. Agent framework landscape: All 3 major providers now have agent SDKs.
